donor_industry.caption: From itemized individual contributions over $200 reported to the FEC, grouped by the donor's self-reported employer and occupation. Employer means where the donor works, not that the company gave money; corporations can't give directly to campaigns. Industry groups use simple keyword rules and may misclassify some donors.
donor_industry.cycle_rule: House filings use the 2026 two-year cycle.

stands_for.caption: Grouped by Congress.gov's official policy area. Shows how they voted, not why. Final-passage, amendment, and procedural votes can mean different things; read the note for each.
stands_for.scope: House roll calls 1–323 of 2026 (323 votes, January 6, 2026 to November 12, 2026), from the House Clerk.
stands_for.majority_rule: Party majority = the Yea/Nay side taken by most members of that party who voted Yea or Nay on that roll call, counted from the party code in the roll-call XML (all members, including ones no longer serving). Ties have no majority.
stands_for.factual_flag: Not yet summarized: this line is built only from the official vote question and the bill's official title.

posts.text: Read more here: https://t.co/lUA87w8qom

I am proud to co-lead the resolution recognizing November as National Adoption Month and November 21st as National Adoption Day.

Uniting families is a cause that goes beyond party lines and Congress must continue to look for ways to strengthen foster care and adoption to help https://t.co/lpQ3KhXxZD

Happy Veterans Day, and thank you to all who have served!

The freedoms we enjoy as Americans did not come without sacrifice. We owe an enormous debt of gratitude to our veterans and their families for their service, courage, and commitment to our nation.

Today, and every day, https://t.co/m14WQ85pnh

It is troubling that the Kazakh government is delaying accreditation for @RFERL journalists. For over 70 years, RFE/RL has provided fair and unbiased news to the people of Kazakhstan, and held a presence inside the country for more than 30 years. 

As the lead sponsor of bipartisan legislation to grant Permanent Normal Trade Relations with Kazakhstan, I believe closer U.S. engagement in Central Asia is vital to address critical minerals vulnerabilities and to counter Chinese influence in a strategic region. It is vital that RFE/RL, a Congressionally funded news organization, continues to operate freely inside Kazakhstan.

I want to thank my friend @SpeakerJohnson for his leadership of the House GOP for the past three years. He inherited an extremely difficult environment and was still able to turn it into legislative win after win. Thank you and I look forward to continuing to serve with you in

America’s economy grew at a strong 3.4% annual rate in Q3, beating expectations. 

We must keep working to lower prices by cutting burdensome regulations. President Trump’s tax cuts passed by the Republican Congress are estimated to benefit the average Alabama family by approximately $6,000, with no federal income tax on qualified tips and overtime.

Lower costs. More take-home pay. A stronger America.

I am deeply concerned by the escalating unrest in NATO Ally Albania. The Albanian people deserve the rule of law, accountable institutions, and the freedom to make their voices heard. All parties must reject violence, and the government must respect the rights of peaceful protesters. Albania’s young people deserve a voice in shaping their nation’s future.

I’m proud to join @VP in the pledge to protect hardworking Americans from waste, fraud, and abuse. 

Every dollar stolen through fraud is money taken from hardworking taxpayers and Americans who genuinely need assistance. @WHFraudTF https://t.co/QCFARYZXTr

I appreciated the opportunity to tour @sheltonstate yesterday and see the new health facilities on campus. 
The new nursing wing will support the college’s growing healthcare programs while modernizing classrooms and labs. https://t.co/nyfnoZ3mIA
Monumental victories for our American farmers and ranchers in the Working Families Tax Cuts! ⬇️ https://t.co/NX1f9TFnpJ

For 50 years, the Hyde Amendment has safeguarded unborn children and ensured Americans aren’t forced to fund abortion.

I am proud to stand for these commonsense protections and remain committed to fighting in Congress to protect unborn lives and uphold the conscience rights of taxpayers.
Read the full release here: https://t.co/e5RbP7iNk1

The Chinese Communist Party’s detention of many political prisoners is an offense against freedom and international human rights. 

The United States must stand and speak up for people of faith everywhere in the world and I call for their immediate release. https://t.co/mevf7sf0AP
Read more here: https://t.co/pLbbgf79ZB

Thanks to President Trump and the Rural Health Transformation Program, Alabama is receiving $203 million to invest in new ways to bring better care closer to home. 

It was an honor to sit down with @DrOzCMS and discuss this huge win for the residents of our rural counties who often struggle to access adequate healthcare.

I was honored to meet the brave men and women of the Alabama National Guard during a tour of the U.S. Capitol. We are deeply grateful for their service and the sacrifices they and their families make to protect our communities and our nation. https://t.co/HkalmYSasF

Today marks 25 years since the September 11 terrorist attacks on America. Our nation has long stood as a beacon of freedom and hope. And even in the face of devastation, our nation answered with strength, unity, and resilience.

We will never forget the innocent lives lost and the bravery, courage, and sacrifice of our first responders.
Read more here: https://t.co/exfuxx2UAj

It was great to join HRSA Administrator Tom Engels in Haleyville, AL as we celebrated an important milestone for rural healthcare.

Rural hospitals are essential to the health and well-being of our communities, and I look forward to seeing this investment help ensure Alabamians, and rural citizens across the country, can continue to receive quality healthcare close to home.

Charlie Kirk was a bright light in a very dark world. He has been gone for a year now, and while we all wish he were still here, his message lives on and his influence is still felt. When I think of Charlie, I’m reminded of the gospel song ‘Is He Worthy?’ and the words, ‘But do you know that all the dark won’t stop the light from getting through? We do.’ Charlie understood that the light of Christ can overcome any darkness, and he dedicated his life to sharing that light with others. One year later, that light continues to shine.

I’m honored to have received the “Friend of the Family” Award from @FaithandFreedom. I will always remain committed to defending religious liberty and strengthening family values. https://t.co/B569idqrfv

I was proud join my @HouseGOP colleagues to vote today to condemn socialism and to reaffirm that America's future must remain rooted in individual liberty, constitutional government and free enterprise. https://t.co/1t2je64KNq

Very sorry to hear of the passing of country music legend Dolly Parton. She brought decades of joy to millions of fans around the world. And was just a great human being. While she is now gone, her music will echo through Appalachia and the world forever.

Caroline and I are so saddened to hear of the passing of Mr. Roy Drinkard, who, at 106 years old, was the oldest living United States Marine.

Mr. Drinkard was many things: a World War II veteran, a successful businessman, a visionary, a philanthropist, and so much more. But beyond all of those accomplishments, Roy was simply a good man and a good friend. I’m grateful to have known him, and even more grateful to have been able to call him my friend.

Caroline and I are keeping his family and all those who loved him in our prayers.

It was an honor to serve alongside my friend Kay Granger on the House Appropriations Committee for so many years. She was a trailblazer, a principled conservative, and a tireless advocate for Texas and our nation. My prayers go out to her family.  https://t.co/xwFNxud3g3

It was great to welcome UK MPs Peter Fortune and Alicia Kearns to Alabama as part of the U.S.-U.K. Parliamentary Exchange.

We enjoyed showing them North Alabama—including a stop at Buc-ee’s, which never fails to impress visitors!

More importantly, this exchange helps strengthen the close partnership between the U.S. and the U.K.

I’m proud to have voted “Yes” for the FY27 NDAA to revitalize the defense industrial base, secure our supply chains, and improve quality of life for our service members and their families.  

This legislation makes the necessary investments to preserve peace through strength and America’s national security.

It was an honor to speak at the burial of America's Time Capsule on July 4th in Philadelphia. America's 250th anniversary has been a time to reflect on our nation's legacy over the past 250 years and look towards the future. https://t.co/nzrgi7IMtX

Today @houseappropsgop hosted one of the first full committee hearings in years. We discussed and examined solutions to prevent government shutdowns and promote a more stable funding process. 

One of Congress’ fundamental roles is to fund the government — shutdowns are reckless and chaotic and the American people deserve better.

It was an honor to meet Pastor Ezra Jin yesterday. He was arrested and imprisoned by the CCP for over 250 days for preaching the Gospel. 

The United States will always stand up and speak out for those persecuted by the CCP for sharing their faith. https://t.co/9dF7TyAUPW

financial_disclosures.caption: Official House financial disclosure filings from the Clerk of the House. A filing lists assets, income, liabilities, and trades the member reported; it is not proof of a conflict or of wrongdoing. Dollar ranges and asset names are in the PDF. This page links to the Clerk's copies and does not score anyone.

funding.heading: Disclosed campaign receipts
funding.detail: Federal cards show the principal campaign committee and OpenFEC totals for one two-year cycle, plus itemized Schedule A contributors. House uses 2026. Senate uses the cycle of the next election (2026, 2028, or 2030). This is not career fundraising and does not include Schedule E outside spending. Governors do not get a federal contribution list.

town_halls.note: There is no national town-hall dataset. Dates are not estimated.

disclosure_note: Disclosed contributions only; donors behind groups that do not report their own donors are not in this feed.
vote_scope: This is not a full career record. The cache is the latest 40 House rolls (2026, rolls 275-314) and 40 Senate votes (119th Congress, session 2, votes 217-256).
